text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have heard the tale—carried upon the 
winds that sweep across the academy 
grounds. 
Tap... such crude antics are not amusing.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, my bad. But I wasn't teasing him, 
y'know. 
Going at it until he's satisfied blows off 
all that frustration, right?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Even so... enough. 
Listen closely, thou unrefined, 
tempestuous vintage.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Even shouldst thou claim victory, my 
resolve shall not waver.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wha—...! Are you totally sure, Senpai? 
I wanna win Best Dancer no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It has to be with you... It has to! 
To pull off something so crazy cool that 
it'll blow her away!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...My apologies, heir to my soul. 
Yet my brilliance is a divine drop born of 
a covenant with one's own spirit.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I swore an oath: to intoxicate the masses. 
And thus, I chose my impassioned dancer... 
Our pact was forged upon unshakeable 
conviction.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Neither of us has any doubt 
or hesitation. 
And modesty? We threw that into the ocean 
ages ago.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...? W-What does that even mean?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It means the missing piece thou seekest is 
not I. —Come with me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaa...! So stylish~~! 
So this is the vintage clothing shop 
Gim-senpai frequents...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Proprietor, prepare a complete ensemble 
befitting a grand ball of intoxication and 
ecstasy. 
What is required is a provocative 
transformation that shatters the mundane.

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you! Welcome! Looking for an 
outfit for the dance party? 
We just received a fresh stock of vintage 
pieces that are just begging to be remade!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering where you were taking me, 
but... picking out an outfit, huh. 
Come to think of it, I hadn't even thought 
about that yet...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
They said rental outfits would be 
available, 
so I was thinking that'd be good enough, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now... question the mirror. 
What is the self in which thou believest?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A 'cool horse girl', of course! 
Let's see... first off, pants are a 
must-have, and the color should be...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Nnnngghhhh... Man, this is tough!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This suit with the chain looks super cool, 
but... what color shirt should I go with? 
Yellow, or blue...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, maybe it's just way too stylish for 
me to pull off in the first place? 
Gim-senpai... Wait, is he heading to the 
fitting room?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(...Why did Senpai bring me here anyway? 
To make up for turning me down... No, 
couldn't be.)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(Tap-senpai is amazing. A truly incredible 
Umamusume. Plus, they already had plans 
beforehand. But why Tap-senpai? It's not 
like they're in the exact same 
generation...)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(They don't really feel like rivals 
either, do they...? Wait, more 
importantly, what is this missing piece 
that I'm lacking...?!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, I don't get it at all! Whatever, 
maybe I'll just go with this simple navy 
one...

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... On you, combining that with this 
would give a sporty, energetic impression 
and look quite sharp, I think.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, yeah, figures. "Sporty and 
energetic," huh? Hehehe, I get told that a 
lot.

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
You could also incorporate coolness as an 
accent. We offer custom alterations as an 
option, such as adding chains or studs...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, if a pro says so... yeah. 
That kind of cool isn't bad either, I 
guess...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
O, lost lamb. 
Are you truly content with that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hwah...! G-Gim-senpaaaai! Whoaaa, you look 
so freaking cool!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Shopkeeper, I shall take 
everything. 
Ring it up at once.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Senpai can even rock a dress, 
huh? I bet you'd look cool in whatever you 
wear...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Nay, this attire is still far too graceful 
for me. 
A cocoon of refined silk is rather 
stifling.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Eh, that's not true at all! It looks crazy 
good on—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I—*we*—deem it so. 
No one else's opinion matters. And 
thus...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If that is what I feel, 
then I must make it submit to my soul!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Mwahahahahahahahaha!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeeek?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing?! Ripping it all of a 
sudden is... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That's so "you"... 
It looks amazingly good on you... That 
outfit was made for Gim-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
W-What a surprise...! Even more intense 
than usual, aren't you... But! Heheh... 
Hahaha! Excellent! Truly so very you!

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
My creative passion is ignited! I can 
craft the ultimate masterpiece here! Now 
then, let's treat these frays and give it 
some distress styling!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Senpai is... seriously an insane 
Umamusume. 
Totally out there in every way. And yet... 
he doesn't doubt himself for a single 
millimeter.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What of you? 
Where does your fanatical devotion lie?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! That's right... I... What I 
believe in is...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...All right! I'm gonna try on that one 
with the chain! Because I think that one's 
the coolest of all!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... The key has turned in the door 
of truth. 
Ah... that very anguish shall mature you.
